title: Working with Red Allen's father's band
summary: Williams played with Henry 'Buddy' Allen's band across the river, which used Emile Barnes and sometimes George Lewis and got plenty of work.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: And I know you work with so many musicians.
And I worked with, uh, with Buddy Allen.
Which one is that? The trumpet player? Red Allen. From over the river.
Yeah. Did he have a good band? Yeah, he had a good band. Well he used to bring boys too from, he used to hire fellas from here, you know, over here. He used to hire fellas from over here.
Who did he have with him?
He used to use Mealy. Mealy Barnes played with him. Sometimes George Lewis played with him. He had different guys, you know.
Yeah, I hope. Did he get a lot of work across the river or mostly over here?
Oh, he had plenty of work over here on this side of the river. He's well known. Oh, yeah. Yeah.
